messages:
sre-incident-bot: Incident created at 2034509876 — Severity: P1. Issue: significant latency and 429s from embeddings endpoint in eu-west-1; customer-facing impact for search and recommendations. Pager: Anya (oncall). War room: https://warroom.redwood.app/r/2034509876
Anya (oncall): got the page, joining war room now. I see alert flood for embeddings-consume-prod in eu-west-1.
Marisol (SRE): I'm here. Can someone confirm recent config changes?
Kevin (Prod-Eng): rolled out an autoscaler policy tweak to embeddings pools in eu-west-1 at 02:05 UTC (policy: "aggressive_downscale"). Rolling back now if needed.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-20-autoscale-policy applied to pool embeddings-eu-west-1 at 2034507300.
Samir (Support): CS reporting multiple customers with elevated 429 rate and delayed embeddings (2-6s). Collecting affected account list.
Anya (oncall): confirming metrics — tail latency spiking, queue length climbing, rejection rate ~18% over last 10m.
Marisol (SRE): ops: set incident owner. I'll take owner role for comms and postmortem. Anya will lead mitigation.
Ops Manager: Assigned Marisol as incident owner.
Marisol (SRE): acknowledged. Anya, please confirm any quick mitigation steps.
Anya (oncall): suggestion: temporarily increase min replicas for embeddings pool to absorb burst. Command:
```
infractl scale --pool embeddings-eu-west-1 --min 8 --max 64
```
Will apply now if approved.
Kevin (Prod-Eng): +1. Also revert autoscaler policy change to previous value: `infractl policy set --pool embeddings-eu-west-1 --policy stable-v1`
Marisol (SRE): do the scale first, then revert policy. Samir, prep a short status page line and targeted customer DM (concise).
statuspage-bot: Draft status update: "Investigating — We're seeing elevated latency and rate-limit errors for embeddings in eu-west-1 affecting some customers. Engineers are mitigating. No data loss suspected. Updates every 10 minutes." Ack to publish?
Samir (Support): ack draft. DM template ready: "We're experiencing higher latency and some rate-limit errors for embeddings in eu-west-1. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we'll update at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2034509876."
Marisol (SRE): include estimated ETA for next update (10m) and note workaround: short retries + 500ms jitter.
Samir (Support): updated DM with workaround and ETA. Will not send until mitigation shows progress.
Anya (oncall): scaling min replicas now (executed at 2034509950). Monitoring.
infra-bot: Scaling job started for embeddings-eu-west-1 at 2034509951.
Anya (oncall): queue depth dropping, tail latency improving within 60s. rejection rate down to 6% at 2034510050.
Kevin (Prod-Eng): rolling back autoscaler policy now to stable-v1 (triggered at 2034510100). Please monitor for oscillation.
Marisol (SRE): update status page to note mitigation in progress once metrics confirm. statuspage-bot: Ready to publish update?
statuspage-bot: Published update: "Mitigating — Increased capacity and autoscaler policy rollback in progress for embeddings in eu-west-1. Some requests may still see elevated latency. Next update in 10 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2034509876
Samir (Support): CS: sending proactive DM to top-10 impacted customers with approved text and link. Notifying #cs-ops channel.
Samir (Support): NOTE for CS: scaling will cause brief reconnections for streaming sessions. Including that in DM.
Anya (oncall): logs show a cascading downscale that coincided with traffic spike; scaling up succeeded. No obvious application-level errors.
Marisol (SRE): great. Can Eng confirm any failed healthchecks or oom events?
Kevin (Prod-Eng): no OOMs. A few pods failed liveness checks during rapid downscale; those were replaced. Cluster events: 'PodEvicted' traces match downscale timing.
Marisol (SRE): root cause hypothesis: aggressive_downscale policy + traffic burst => insufficient capacity => 429/rejections. Mitigation: scale up + policy revert. Next steps: pin stable policy, add safety floor, postmortem.
Anya (oncall): continuing to monitor. setting 30m stabilization window before declaring resolved. Handoff plan: if need to hand off, leave summary with metrics, actions, and owner. Handoff time tentatively 2034513400 UTC.
Ops Manager: please prepare internal brief for leadership once we hit stable. Include customer list, ETA, and mitigation steps.
Samir (Support): CS loop closed for now; top customers acknowledged. I'll reopen if any complain.
Marisol (SRE): preparing internal customer impact note and incident doc. Samir, please attach list of affected accounts to the incident doc after the thread.
statuspage-bot: Status updated to "mitigating" at 2034510200. Next scheduled update in 10m.
Anya (oncall): metrics stable for 5m, 429s at ~2%. continuing watch.
Kevin (Prod-Eng): as a precaution, we'll add a guard in our rollout process to require a min-replicas floor when changing autoscaler policies.
Marisol (SRE): agree. Also add an alert to detect rapid downscales during high RPS.
Anya (oncall): note for handoff: observed spike timeline, commands executed (scale + rollback), current metrics snapshot, and list of follow-ups.
Marisol (SRE): I'll host the war room until stabilization; if anyone needs to hand off, please post a succinct bullet summary in the war room and here.
Samir (Support): DM log: sent to impacted list at 2034510305. Customers thanked us for quick updates.
Marisol (SRE): thanks team. keeping thread open until stable 30m window. will post final status update then move to postmortem scheduling.
sre-incident-bot: Incident state updated to "mitigating" at 2034510420.
Anya (oncall): will flag if any regressions. leaving monitoring hooks and runbook links in the war room.
Marisol (SRE): final note for this kickoff: owner=Marisol, oncall=Anya, initial mitigation=scaling & policy rollback, customer comms sent, war room active.
statuspage-bot: Next update scheduled at 2034510800.
Marisol (SRE): closing active mitigation actions log at 2034511400; war room remains open for monitoring. I'll post if we hit full stabilization.
